primary_task: RENGE day4 source response -> day5 response, one-day early-response prediction, four development TFs held out
primary_metric: equal-TF pseudobulk MSE in one frozen log-PCA coordinate system
hyperparameters: ridge chosen separately per arm by leave-one-training-TF-out; common condition embeddings and train-fold StandardScaler
estimator: retrained FrozenInnovationControl kinetic GFGv2, no JVP, compact reconstruction auxiliary; velocity is shared linear head, not original GFG architecture
velocity_units: normalized-S rate proxy, not calibrated physical days; forecast learns one-day displacement
group_definition: condition-level source population, no target expression used to define groups
population_control: swap source mean U between mutual S-nearest condition populations, depth match recipient U; keep S and ESM condition unchanged
inference_scope: development only; four validation TFs and historical reuse do not support final confirmation; seed variation is not independent biological replication
